name: mil188qammod
expr: y16 = mil188qammod(x16, 16); z16 = mil188qamdemod(y16, 16); rt16 = isequal(x16, z16); y32 = mil188qammod(x32, 32); z32 = mil188qamdemod(y32, 32); rt32 = isequal(x32, z32); zn32 = mil188qamdemod(y32 + 0.02*(1+1i), 32); rtN32 = isequal(x32, zn32);
comment: MATLAB mil188qammod / mil188qamdemod (MIL-STD-188-110 QAM). Bit-equal with MATLAB R2025b on both M=16 and M=32 constellations. Both tables hard-coded per MATLAB's spec-rounded values (probed at %.17g). KNOWN GAP: M=64, M=256 still deferred (each is a separate constellation table). Octave 11.1.0 doesn't ship mil188qam in core; reports N/A.
